mechanism: One reusable reference identity preserves a nominal head, ownership, labels and qualifiers through reading, fact emission, asks, relation anchors and totals. Extend it with user-approved forward discourse item-class binding: a later compatible bare item mention may refer to one earlier established qualified class, with explicit provenance and ambiguity controls. Preserve exact-match versus unique-reference resolution and whole/subset safety. Do not combine or promote the rejected feature branches.
risks: Reference identity must distinguish actor descriptors from measure qualifiers, predicate/time scope and numerical source evidence.
Do not change identity solely on a value collision; equal-valued different participants are still different.
Do not replace general discourse/coreference with a nearest-mention guess or introduce universal identity facts.
The old rejected branches include separate useful features and repairs but remain unapproved and must not be merged.
No TEST/generalization, corpus prose, main writes, server intervention, automatic promotion or push.
Generation and adversarial evidence must run in both curated and the declared GSM8K runtime; unknown vocabulary cannot stand in for a semantic decline.

Legacy review replay may accept only newly added dataclass-declared reference metadata while preserving exact prior fact multiplicity, type, source, sentence and recorded fields. Recorded identity remains exact; arbitrary or malformed additions fail closed. This reconfirms the old captured contract, not human approval of the newly added identity detail.
A consistent unnamed possessor is anchored only within the current document; no named antecedent or standalone pronoun binding is invented.
Qualifier differences constrain selection but do not independently establish distinctness. Explicit labels/owners still distinguish comparison roles.

Event comparisons require complete per-predicate totals; additional unquantified events and unsupported event-period or offset scopes decline. Only legacy derived missing modifiers may alias actually observed uniquely qualified evidence. A direct bare event amount cannot establish a qualified subset or be ignored alongside qualified events.
New review reference metadata must be resolved and coherent with the captured legacy descriptors; machine reconfirmation does not approve newly exposed identity information.

State comparisons resolve omitted measures and explicit item modifiers in both directions. A stated bare whole cannot establish a qualified subset, and a derived bare projection cannot replace directly stated qualified evidence.

Dataclass-declared qualifier-for emission inherits a direct measure slot modifier only for absent or literal-null fields; explicit non-null YAML remains authoritative. Newly preserved item qualifiers require fresh human review, not reference-only replay enrichment.
All decoded reference heads, including recursive owners, must be nonblank; malformed metadata cannot reconfirm saved reviews.

The new item-class capability is forward-only comparison-connected anaphora, not universal coreference: an actual earlier comparison, matching full participant/predicate/item, unique prior class inventory, and no explicit whole, modal or time scope are required. Earlier bare amounts remain bare.

ItemClassReference preserves literal quantity fields and records exact target/antecedent provenances. Arithmetic projections revalidate the typed source/rival inventory and reader eligibility index. Forged, stale or malformed links fail closed; item-scope enrichment is not reference-only saved-review compatibility.

Typed qualified single-entity asks reuse the same subset evidence projection as comparisons. An adjective appearing only in the ask cannot establish a subset, and start-state ambiguity checks still inspect the original evidence.

Native strict generation covers the existing atomic plural filler. A deterministic qualified boundary variant is separately authored and round-tripped; it is not represented as native composed-filler generation.

Genuinely omitted comparison items retain a uniquely observed standard item modifier through shared effective relation resolution, while the original relation remains unchanged. Explicit bare item scope never inherits a subset, and a bare whole is a rival scope during modifier uniqueness. Subtype discrimination checks full typed owner and label evidence rather than legacy flat descriptors.
